description: This file defines interfaces, extension methods, and a configurator class for setting up EventHub stream data generation within an Orleans silo. It includes configuration extensions for data adapters and cache pressure, as well as a concrete configurator class that initializes and registers relevant services and options for the EventDataGenerator stream.

classes.name: IEventDataGeneratorStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Interface for configuring EventDataGenerator stream in Orleans, extending ISiloRecoverableStreamConfigurator.

classes.name: EventDataGeneratorConfiguratorExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IEventDataGeneratorStreamConfigurator, including use of data adapters and cache pressure configuration.

classes.name: EventDataGeneratorStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Concrete class implementing the configurator for EventDataGenerator stream, handling registration of options, validators, and service configurations during silo setup.

methods.name: UseDataAdapter
methods.description: Extension method to set a factory function for creating EventHub data adapters within the stream configurator.

methods.name: ConfigureCachePressuring
methods.description: Extension method to configure cache pressure options for the EventDataGenerator stream.

methods.name: EventDataGeneratorStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the configurator with stream name and service configuration delegate, setting up required service registrations and options.
